CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_TicketsSuscriptor_ObtenerTicketsPorSuscriptor] 
@SuscriptorId INT
AS
BEGIN
SELECT
	Ticket.Id,
	Ticket.Titulo AS [TituloTicket],
	Ticket.Descripcion AS [DescripcionTicket],
	Ticket.Comunidad_Id,
	Comunidad.Nombre AS [Comunidad],
	Suscriptor.Id AS [SuscriptorID],
	(Suscriptor.Nombre + ' ' + Suscriptor.ApellidoPaterno + ' ' + Suscriptor.ApellidoMaterno) AS [NombreUsuario],
	Suscriptor.CorreoElectronico,
	Ticket.Membresia_Id,
	Membresia.ClaveMembresia,
	Ticket.FechaCreacion AS [FechaCreacionTicket],
	Ticket.FechaModificacion AS [FechaModificacionTicket],
	Ticket.EstatusTicket_Id,
	EstatusTicket.Nombre AS [EstatusTicket],
	Ticket.CategoriaTicket_Id,
	CategoriaTicket.Nombre AS [CategoriaTicket],
	CategoriaTicket.Descripcion AS [DescripcionCategoriaTicket]
FROM Suscriptor
	LEFT JOIN Ticket
		ON Suscriptor.Id = Ticket.Suscriptor_Id
	LEFT JOIN Comunidad
		ON Ticket.Comunidad_Id = Comunidad.Id
	LEFT JOIN Membresia
		ON Ticket.Membresia_Id = Membresia.Id
	LEFT JOIN EstatusTicket
		ON Ticket.EstatusTicket_Id = EstatusTicket.Id
	LEFT JOIN CategoriaTicket
		ON Ticket.CategoriaTicket_Id = CategoriaTicket.Id
WHERE Suscriptor.Id = @SuscriptorId
AND Ticket.Activo = 1
END
Name: rpt_TicketsSuscriptor_ObtenerTicketsPorSuscriptor
